note: Upgrades that add a second item to what a minion produces, rather than changing its speed or its packing. These are the difference between a minion's headline drop and its actual output, and leaving them out is why the single best-known coin setup in the game — a mob minion with Corrupt Soil selling into an Enchanted Hopper — was invisible in a profit table that modelled every other slot.
source: Hypixel Wiki: Corrupt Soil, Minion Upgrades (spreading and other upgrades), Automated Shipping.
offlineOnly: Every amount here is the OFFLINE figure, matching the rest of this app. Corrupt Soil and the Enchanted Egg both behave differently with a player on the island — the wiki files the multi-drop behaviour under Bugs — and the loaded case is not modelled anywhere in this project.

extras.name: Corrupt Soil
extras.quote: When placed in a minion, Corrupt Soil Corrupts all mobs spawned by the minion. This makes the mobs drop 1 Sulphur and 1 Corrupted Fragment.
extras.why: Two extra items on every harvest, and on a cheap mob minion they are worth more than the mob's own drop. A Slime Minion's slimeball sells to a shopkeeper for 5; the Sulphur alone is 10. That is the whole reason the setup exists, and a table without it ranks the strategy below minions nobody uses.
extras.idWarning: Sulphur is SULPHUR_ORE, not SULPHUR. SULPHUR is Gunpowder — the Creeper Minion's drop — and the two names are swapped relative to what anyone would guess. Pricing this against SULPHUR values it at 4 instead of 10 and quietly halves the strategy.
extras.restrictedWhy: Mob-spawning minions only — the upgrade corrupts a mob, so a minion that spawns none has nothing to corrupt.
extras.loadedNote: While the island is loaded this triggers per loot-table entry, so Revenant, Voidling, Skeleton, Tarantula, Magma Cube and Slime minions can produce several of each. The wiki files that under Bugs and publishes no rate for it; this models the offline one.

extras.name: Diamond Spreading
extras.quote: 10% chance per drop of generating a Diamond.
extras.why: A tenth of a diamond a harvest is small but it is not nothing, and it is the same shape of fact as Corrupt Soil — an upgrade slot that pays in items rather than in speed.

extras.name: Enchanted Egg
extras.quote: While the island is unloaded, only one Egg will be made per cycle.
extras.why: The wiki gives the loaded figure as two and the unloaded as one, and states both. This is the unloaded one.

extras.name: Enchanted Shears
extras.quote: Shears the sheep after they spawn, which gives 1-3 Wool, averaging to 2 Wool per sheep.
extras.why: The wiki gives the average outright, so no midpoint has to be invented.

notModelled.potatoSpreading: 5% Potato, but limited to one of any minion, so it is not a setup that scales.
notModelled.sleepyHollow: 0.015% Purple Candy, and only during the Great Spook.
notModelled.krampusHelmet: 0.0045% Red Gift. Both of these are rounding error on any timescale.
notModelled.soulflowEngines: Produce Raw Soulflow on a cooldown rather than per harvest, and halve the minion's own output doing it. The output halving IS modelled, in minion_modifiers.json; the soulflow itself is not.
notModelled.berberisInjector: Lush Berberis on a five-minute cooldown, which is a rate per hour rather than per harvest and does not fit this table's shape.
notModelled.superJacob: One Jacob's Ticket every three hours, same reason.
